{"tool_calls":[{"function":{"arguments":"{\"content\":\"---\\nname: ce_logs\\ndescription: Unified log access commands and API\\ntype: reference\\n---\\n\\n## Overview\\n\\nThe `ce logs` command group provides unified log access across multiple sources (capture, proxy, app, agent) with consistent filtering, stats, and search capabilities.\\n\\n## Commands\\n\\n| Command | Description |\\n|---------|-------------|\\n| `ce logs` | View log entries with `--source`, `--provider`, `--date`, `--grep`, `--tail` filtering |\\n| `ce logs-sources` | Discover available log sources and sub-sources |\\n| `ce logs-stats` | Volume stats: sizes, file/archive counts, per-provider and per-date breakdowns |\\n| `ce logs-search` | Regex search across all log sources with `--date-start`/`--date-end` range |\\n\\n## Implementation\\n\\n- **Package**: `internal/logs/` with 7 tests\\n- **API endpoints**: `/api/logs`, `/api/logs/sources`, `/api/logs/stats`, `/api/logs/search`\\n- **CLI commands**: Added to `internal/funcs/funcs.go`\\n\\n## Key Design Decisions\\n\\n1. **Centralized API**: CLI commands call API endpoints rather than shell-out to `du`, `ls`, `grep` — keeps code centralized and testable\\n2. **Log source registry**: Map of source name → directory path + file pattern + parse format, extensible for future sources\\n3. **Compressed file handling**: Gracefully handles zstd, gzip compression\\n4. **Date filtering**: Consistent filtering across sources with different date formats\\n\\n## Benefits\\n\\n- **Visibility**: Agents and Eric can now inspect logs without raw shell commands\\n- **Search**: Regex search across all log sources\\n- **Stats**: Volume tracking helps identify what's valuable vs. what's stale\\n- **Prevents incidents**: Provides visibility needed to avoid accidental log deletion\\n\",\"file_path\":\"/workspace/sessions/reflect-109fd65608101a3fb837f9dc/memory/ce_logs.md\"}","name":"Write"},"id":"call_c3559a97d7534cfa84c52003a6c30b2c","type":"function"}]}
